mots.sens: This name of God, often translated as 'LORD', evokes the idea of the Supreme Being, the creator and sovereign of the universe. In this verse, the invocation of YHWH reminds believers that their protection and salvation depend entirely on Him, thus reinforcing their faith and dependence on the divine.
